description: This file defines the FileService class which manages file uploads, downloads, deletion, and backup handling within a larger application. It interacts with various external modules for cryptography, file operations, and API communication.

classes.name: FileService
classes.description: A service class responsible for handling file operations such as upload, download, delete, and backup management, integrating with cryptography, API, and cache mechanisms.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Cleans up resources and references when the service is deinitialized.

methods.name: minimumChunkSize
methods.description: Returns the minimum size of file chunks for upload.

methods.name: beginNewFileUpload
methods.description: Initiates a new file upload session, generating necessary tokens and keys.

methods.name: pushBytesForUpload
methods.description: Pushes a chunk of bytes to the ongoing upload operation.

methods.name: finishUpload
methods.description: Completes the upload process, creating a file item and syncing.

methods.name: decryptCachedEntry
methods.description: Decrypts a cached encrypted file entry.

methods.name: downloadFile
methods.description: Downloads a file, utilizing cache, backup, or network as needed, and reports progress.

methods.name: deleteFile
methods.description: Deletes a file from server and local cache, with user confirmation if needed.

methods.name: isFileNameFileBackupRelated
methods.description: Checks if a filename is related to file backup metadata or binary data.

methods.name: decryptBackupMetadataFile
methods.description: Decrypts backup metadata files to retrieve file items.

methods.name: readBackupFileAndSaveDecrypted
methods.description: Reads a backup file, decrypts it, and saves the decrypted data to a specified location.

methods.name: readBackupFileBytesDecrypted
methods.description: Reads and decrypts backup file bytes into a Uint8Array.
